name: vlm_monoastral_spindle_presence
description: Visually estimates the prevalence of monoastral spindles (rosette-like chromatin surrounded by a radial microtubule array). This specific phenotype is the hallmark of Eg5 inhibition (e.g., Monastrol) and is visually distinct but hard to code geometrically.
segmentation_prompt: Segment individual cells to isolate potential mitotic figures.
method_rationale: Identifying a 'rosette' chromatin pattern with radial microtubules requires high-level pattern recognition that VLMs handle better than rule-based geometry.
